title: Lendflow Broker Roundup | November 2026
summary: November's Broker Roundup covers Lendflow's equipment financing workflow, Claude AI connector, and SBA lender broker referral programs.
body_markdown:
This month, we're highlighting new ways Lendflow is helping business acquisition brokers and platforms create more connected financing experiences. From a dedicated SBA loan workflow to an integrated financing partnership with Bizbe, explore how technology is making it easier to connect qualified buyers with capital. Plus, take a look at the latest lending statistics shaping the market in 2026.


##### LENDFLOW NEWS


#### [Lendflow Expands MCP Capabilities to Support SBA Loan Processing Through AI](https://www.lendflow.com/post/expanded-sba-lending-capabilities-through-lendflows-ai-connectors)


Lendflow is expanding its MCP capabilities to support more SBA lending workflows directly within AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. This update will give lending teams new ways to manage SBA loan processes using natural language, helping streamline operations and reduce manual work.

#### [Lendflow's Equipment Financing Workflow](https://www.lendflow.com/post/lendflow-equipment-financing-workflow)


Introducing Lendflow's new Equipment Financing Workflow, designed to help brokers streamline equipment financing applications, simplify document collection, and connect borrowers with lenders through one centralized platform. Explore how the dedicated workflow reduces manual steps.
